Marta: Kicking off SI BridgeCamp Week 0. Quick sync on runbook & deliverables. Agenda: https://redwood.example.com/si/bridgecamp/agenda. @Ben can you confirm trainer roster? @Sam can ops handle sandbox creds?

Ben: Trainer roster final, adding Carlos + Priya. Will upload to the doc.

Sam: Ops can support sandbox. Need 24h lead for GPU quota and IAM roles. I'll ping eng-infra.

Jules: Marketplace listing checklist needs sign-off by Fri. Draft publish command below:
```
/marketplace/publish --partner=SI-Bridge --artifact=redwood-inference --region=us-west-2
```
I'll attach the full checklist after this thread.

Marta: Certification tracks proposal: Integrator (basic) and Advanced (deep integration + HW). Format: practical lab + short MCQ. Thoughts?

Ben: Yes. Practical + 20 MCQs. Pass threshold 70%. Labs graded pass/fail per rubric.

Sam: Lab infra suggestion: ephemeral VMs with pre-baked AMI and KV-cache snapshot. Ops cost estimate: ~$120 per trainee for a 3-day lab (GPU + storage). Need budget approval.

Jules: We'll fold cost into partner kit pricing and marketplace listing. I'll draft a short TCO note for field teams.

Marta: Who owns the playbook PDF? Must include: onboarding checklist, trainer slides, lab infra spec, certification rubric, joint announcement plan, contacts.

Priya: I can own trainer slides. Will sync with Ben on exercises and timing.

Ben: Assigned. I'll add exercise scripts and acceptance criteria to the roster doc. Proposed cohort start: 2026-04-06.

OncallBot: Reminder: create incident channel before first cohort. Use `/create-channel si-bridgecamp-oncall` or confirm and I will auto-create.

Sam: Channel created: #si-bridgecamp-oncall. Added a short infra runbook for common failures.

Marta: Action items recap: Ben — roster & exercises; Priya — slides; Jules — marketplace checklist + TCO note; Sam — infra cost breakdown + runbook/channel. Reconvene Wed 15:00 PT to review playbook draft. :thumbsup:
